_comment: Research candidates as of 2026-10-19. NONE is verified against primary sources; every figure is from secondary reporting found via web search (direct page fetches failed in the build environment). status=candidate means paper/shadow only. See docs/01-research-2026-10-19.md for sources and labels.

finalists.thesis: BTC is range-bound near 80-88k into the Oct 27-28 FOMC with a hawkish Fed (Sept hike, Sept CPI 3.7% y/y). Liquidity anchor: the live loop must prove net-of-cost skill here before any altcoin.
bear_case: A hike plus hawkish guidance breaks the 80k support
ETF outflows continue (weekly net outflow reported ~228m)
Stablecoin supply flat to down: no new marginal buyer
invalidation: Funding turns persistently negative alongside rising open interest

finalists.thesis: Hyperliquid routes most perp fees to open-market HYPE buybacks; it ranks among the top holder-revenue protocols on DefiLlama (page dated 2026-10-18). Value accrual is mechanical, not promised.
catalysts: Any volatility spike raises perp volume and therefore buybacks (speculative)
bear_case: Monthly contributor unlocks reported ~9.9m HYPE through 2027 (data as of mid-2026; team reportedly cut some allocations)
Reported buyback capacity 60-80m/month can be below unlock value
Fees fall in quiet markets: the buyback is pro-cyclical
Perp-DEX competition (e.g. Aster) and regulatory risk
invalidation: 30-day holder revenue down >50% vs prior 30 days
Exchange inflows from contributor wallets around unlock dates
Sustained loss of perp-DEX volume share

finalists.thesis: Uniswap fee switch live since Dec 2025 with a 100m UNI burn; value now accrues to the token. Watch-list only: reported annualized protocol revenue (26-58m, estimates differ) looks small against valuation and the price did not re-rate after activation.
catalysts: Fee switch extension to more pools/chains (reported March and June 2026)
bear_case: Reported 20m UNI/year growth issuance can offset burns
Price ~3.4-3.7 after activation suggests the market already priced it
Fee revenue is cyclical with DEX volume
invalidation: 30-day holder revenue falls below the growth-budget issuance value
Governance raises issuance or redirects fees away from burns

finalists.thesis: Ethena fee switch reportedly approved Sept 2026 but ENA buybacks only start when USDe supply reaches 7.5bn; USDe was reported ~5bn on 2026-10-07. Optionality on the trigger, not a confirmed catalyst.
bear_case: Low funding compresses USDe yield, which historically shrank supply (peak 14.7bn Oct 2025, -56% by Dec 2025 as reported)
Scheduled unlocks around Nov 1-5 (sources disagree on date and size)
Buyback split percentages are unsettled across sources
invalidation: Governance changes the trigger or the revenue split

finalists.thesis: Reported unlock of ~78m ASTER on 2026-11-17 (~3.9% of market cap per one source) into a market with altcoin weakness and BTC dominance near 58-60%. Supply-overhang trade.
catalysts: Unlock 2026-11-17 (single secondary source; verify on Tokenomist/CryptoRank)
bear_case: Unlock shorts are a crowded, well-known trade: likely priced in
Crowded shorts mean negative funding (shorts pay) and squeeze risk
Unlock recipients may not sell (locked staking, OTC)
invalidation: Funding below -30% annualized (carry kills the trade)
Price rises through the unlock window on rising open interest
